polityNote: Egypt (United Arab Republic 1958-1971, Arab Republic of Egypt since). Sinai occupied by Israel 1967-1982 (returned in stages to 1982-04-25); Gaza (Egyptian-administered 1948-1967) is not an EGY atom; the Halaib triangle (claimed by Sudan) lies in NE's Red Sea feature.

events.what: Sinai governorate split into North and South Sinai; some parts added to the three Canal governorates

events.what: Helwan split from Cairo and 6th of October from Giza

sources.title: Statoids — Governorates of Egypt
sources.says: 2008-04-17 presidential decree created Helwan and Sixth of October.

sources.title: Statoids — Governorates of Egypt
sources.says: 2009-12-07 Luxor governorate officially split from Qina.

events.what: Helwan merged back into Cairo and 6th of October into Giza (SCAF decree 63)

unresolved.why: NE's Egyptian outlines do not match the official extents of any dated layout: official areas (SIS/CAPMAS, ar.wikipedia list) give e.g. Asyut 25,926, Sohag 11,022, Aswan 62,726, Giza 85,153 km² where NE has 2,607 / 2,651 / 15,592 / 37,595 km² — the desert hinterlands assigned to Nile governorates by presidential decrees sit in NE's Red Sea / New Valley features. The decrees could not be dated, so no NE line can be tied to a period.
checked: statoids.com/ueg.html (change list: Sinai split 1979/~1984, Helwan & 6 October 2008-04-17 → 2011-04-12, Luxor 2009-12-07; «numerous border adjustments»)
